adm_residual_decomposition.general_normal_projection: n^nu nabla^mu E_munu=-L_n H+K H-D_i M^i-2 a_i M^i+K^ij S_ij
adm_residual_decomposition.general_spatial_projection: h_i^nu nabla^mu E_munu=L_n M_i-K M_i+H a_i+D_j S^j_i+S_ij a^j

constraint_propagation_contract.boundary_condition_scope: On a domain with boundary, maximally dissipative or otherwise constraint-preserving incoming-characteristic data are additionally required.
constraint_propagation_contract.coordinate_hamiltonian: (partial_t-L_beta)H=-alpha D_i M^i+2 alpha K H-2 M^i D_i alpha
constraint_propagation_contract.coordinate_momentum: (partial_t-L_beta)M_i=-alpha D_i H+alpha K M_i-2 H D_i alpha
constraint_propagation_contract.local_result: For smooth lapse, shift, slice geometry, and solved scalar-matter equations, the homogeneous symmetric-hyperbolic constraint system has a unique local zero solution when H=M_i=0 initially.
constraint_propagation_contract.momentum_form: L_n M_i=K M_i-D_i H-2 H a_i
constraint_propagation_contract.normal_form: L_n H=2 K H-D_i M^i-2 a_i M^i
constraint_propagation_contract.result_scope: This establishes propagation of the Einstein constraints for the frozen standard ADM representative, not positivity of the physical Hamiltonian, well-posedness of the full metric-scalar-matter evolution, or global existence.
constraint_propagation_contract.symmetrizer: diag(1,h^ij), positive definite for a spacelike slice

geometry_conventions.normal_evolution: L_n is the Lie derivative along n^mu
geometry_conventions.spatial_derivative: D is the Levi-Civita derivative of h_munu

limitations: Constraint propagation is conditional on the scalar and universal-matter equations and on smooth ADM coefficients.
The standard trace-reversed ADM evolution representative is fixed; other off-constraint evolution adjustments have different propagation systems.
A bounded domain additionally needs constraint-preserving incoming-characteristic boundary data, which are not instantiated here.
Symmetric hyperbolicity of the constraint subsystem does not prove strong hyperbolicity or physical Hamiltonian positivity of the full metric-scalar-matter system.
No physical background, lensing prediction, Solar/GW/cosmological pass, observational evidence, novelty, or publication claim follows.

off_shell_identity_contract.constraint_source_condition: E_phi=E_chi=0 and the matter equations imply nabla^mu E_munu=0.
off_shell_identity_contract.matter_condition: The universal conformal matter equations hold, so nabla_mu T_E^mu_nu=-Q_phi nabla_nu phi-Q_chi nabla_nu chi.
off_shell_identity_contract.metric_identity: nabla^mu E_munu=-E_phi nabla_nu phi-E_chi nabla_nu chi.
off_shell_identity_contract.scope: This is the same-action scalar-matter exchange identity plus the standard contracted Bianchi identity. It is not an independent computer-algebra derivation of the Einstein-Hilbert boundary variation.

standard_adm_evolution_representative.on_constraint_equivalence: When H=0, S_ij=0, so the representative is exactly the spatial Einstein equation on the constraint surface.
standard_adm_evolution_representative.reason_for_choice: This is the standard trace-reversed ADM evolution representative; the unadjusted S_ij=0 representative has a weak principal constraint subsystem off the constraint surface.
standard_adm_evolution_representative.three_dimensional_equivalence: The spatial trace gives S=3H and the trace-free equations give S_ij=H h_ij.

checks.statement: The projected normal-spatial contraction returns M_i.
The double spatial projection returns S_ij.
The trace-reversed spatial trace enforces S=3H.
After the spatial trace, F_ij=0 is exactly S_ij=H h_ij.
The scalar-off-shell metric identity cancels the same-action stress divergence.
Direct four-dimensional divergence matches the general normal ADM projection.
Direct four-dimensional divergence matches all three spatial ADM projections.
S_ij=Hh_ij gives the ADM Hamiltonian propagation equation.
S_ij=Hh_ij gives the ADM momentum propagation equation.
The lapse-shift Hamiltonian form equals alpha times the normal form.
The lapse-shift momentum form equals alpha times the normal form.
The unit-direction principal matrix is symmetric under the positive constraint-energy symmetrizer.
The principal constraint energy has flux H M^i.
H_standard=2H reproduces the standard ADM normalization.
The homogeneous propagation right-hand side vanishes at zero constraints.
